profile.name: Erste Group Bank AG
profile.summary: Erste Group Bank AG provides various banking and other financial services to retail, corporate, and public sector customers. It offers savings and current accounts, and term deposit products; consumer credit and mortgage lending; commercial real estate, investment loan, acquisition and leveraged finance, project finance, and product neutral financial advice; and factoring, accounts receivable purchasing, working capital finance, and structured trade finance, and ErsteConfirming, a supply chain finance solution. The company also provides interests and FX hedging, letters of credit, documentary collections, and guarantees; cash-management solutions, such as cash pooling, payment transactions, digital banking, payment factory, VIRTUAL.IBAN, and POS-terminals and e-commerce; equity interests and investments, revolving export credit lines, and customer financing. In addition, it offers loan syndication, debt capital market, and equity capital market services; custody and brokerage services, including safekeeping, settlement, corporate action events, tax reclaim assistance, proxy voting, brokerage services, securities lending, cash management, clearing services for remote members on Vienna Stock Exchange, and market news services; and George, a digital retail product. The company operates in Austria, the Czech Republic, Poland, Slovakia, Bosnia, Romania, Hungary, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia, and internationally. Erste Group Bank AG was founded in 1819 and is based in Vienna, Austria.
profile.summary_fr: Erste Group Bank AG fournit divers services bancaires et autres services financiers aux particuliers, aux entreprises et aux clients du secteur public. Il offre des comptes d'épargne et des comptes courants, des produits de dépôt à terme; crédit à la consommation et prêts hypothécaires; immobilier commercial, prêt d'investissement, acquisition et financement à effet de levier, financement de projets et conseils financiers neutres; et l'affacturage, l'achat de comptes clients, le financement du fonds de roulement et le financement structuré du commerce, et ErsteConfirming, une solution de financement de la chaîne d'approvisionnement. La société fournit également des intérêts et des couvertures de change, des lettres de crédit, des collections documentaires et des garanties; solutions de gestion de trésorerie, telles que la mise en commun de trésorerie, les transactions de paiement, la banque numérique, l'usine de paiement, VIRTUAL.IBAN et les terminaux de point de vente et le commerce électronique; participations et investissements, lignes de crédit à l'exportation renouvelables et financement de la clientèle.
